scope: source + local validation only; no hosted/provider/capital action performed

1_automated_gate.behaviour: proposed retrain/mutate/revalidate/retire decisions whose target resolves through the persona/registry owners to a paper-only, tenant-owned discovery persona artifact are reviewed then approved as automated_gate; each check is written to the review/approve note and to an append-only evidence sink before state moves. Any other action, risk, proposer, stage, tenant or an owner outage is left proposed for the operator.
1_automated_gate.decision_model: evolution_decision.py: new MUTATE action (low risk); a paper-stage retire of a discovery target is low risk only with metadata.discovery_auto_scope=true, otherwise retire stays high (committee). validate() recomputes risk so a forged low retire fails.
1_automated_gate.tests: services/evolution/test_auto_consumer.py (25, incl. end-to-end against the real evolution FastAPI app), services/control-plane/governance/test_evolution_decision.py TestDiscoveryAutoScopeRisk; services/evolution/test_auto_consumer_runtime.py (allocated persona resolves with no injected metadata; fail-closed cases)
1_automated_gate.startup: services/evolution/auto_consumer_runtime.py: DiscoveryBindingScope resolves scope from the allocator's own records (Capital pcb-discovery-* paper binding with metadata.strategy_spec_registry_id -> Registry artifact lineage.source_strategy_spec_id -> Persona owner tenant/lifecycle); no persona metadata marker is read. Hooked into scheduler_worker behind EVOLUTION_AUTO_CONSUMER_ENABLED; fails closed. HttpDecisionPort now filters with decision_state.

2_random_search.behaviour: fixed budget (default 50, env RESEARCH_RETRAIN_SEARCH_BUDGET) of distinct on-grid variants inside declared mutation_surface ranges, scored by walk-forward folds carved from the in-sample window only; the OOS slice is never passed to the backend (test asserts every window ends before the OOS start). _retrain_parameter_update (2<->3 / 0<->0.01 toggle) deleted; no governed dataset => run ends no_candidate/in_sample_dataset_unavailable (fail closed, no fallback).

3_mutate_lineage.implementation: services/registry/factor_rule.py mutate_factor_rule_structure (change_window, swap_operator within same-type family, add_filter from governed feature catalogue with declared controls, remove_filter, change_exit); evolution_search.build_child_artifact
3_mutate_lineage.behaviour: child is a validated factor_rule_v1 artifact, parent untouched, lineage.parent_registry_ids=[parent], source_run_ids include the decision; non-factor_rule parents refused.
3_mutate_lineage.tests: services/registry/test_factor_rule.py (structural mutation tests), test_evolution_search.py; services/research/tests/test_evolution_gate_executor.py (approved mutate -> candidate_created; failed OOS -> no registration; revalidate; fail-closed dataset)
3_mutate_lineage.execution: services/research/alpha_replication/evolution_executor.py + services/research/main.py _execute_evolution_gate: approved mutate/revalidate runs are started by the existing dispatch route (_trigger_retrain_execution), judged by the real section-10 ReplicationGate on a real backtest (run_replication_backtest_protocol, recorded in BacktestRunStore), passing children registered as candidates via POST /api/registry/strategy-artifacts with parent lineage, terminal outcome+receipt on the run and task. Failed OOS never registers.

4_oos_and_trials.implementation: evolution_search.judge_child_out_of_sample / run_mutation_decision; search_in_sample increments FamilyTrialCounterStore once per evaluated variant
4_oos_and_trials.behaviour: every child goes through the section-10 ReplicationGate (real OOS backtest, deflated Sharpe) and only passers are registered; the gate adds to the family trial count, and search variants are counted too, so counts accumulate per family across decisions. services/research/alpha_replication/shared_stores.py: SharedFamilyTrialCounterStore, SharedBacktestRunStore and SharedReplicationGate reload under an exclusive flock and write atomically; the revalidation worker (gate + run store), the retrain search and the mutate/revalidate executor all use them (gate.py itself is outside this task's artifact contract and unchanged), so the gate, revalidation worker and search can never lose each other's trials.
4_oos_and_trials.tests: test_evolution_search.py (trial counts 50 -> 60; judged children register only on pass); test_gate_and_search_writers_interleave_without_losing_trials, test_trial_counter_concurrent_processes_do_not_lose_updates

5_retire_on_decay.behaviour: persistent paper decay (3 under-baseline windows plus Sharpe<50% baseline or drawdown>1.25x) produces a discovery-scoped retire proposal; the gate approves it and the persona goes paper_owner -> frozen -> retired through the persona lifecycle port using the approval id as governance decision; idempotent; live/other states refused.
5_retire_on_decay.tests: test_auto_consumer.py decay tests and test_decayed_strategy_is_retired_end_to_end_through_the_real_evolution_service; test_auto_consumer_runtime.py: paper decay telemetry drives governed retire through the real evolution service, retry after outage, replay idempotent, missing baseline never retires
5_retire_on_decay.governed_path: services/evolution/governed_persona_lifecycle.py: each exact persona/from/to retire step is proposed (proposer token), reviewed and decided (distinct automated_gate token, low risk) through the existing /api/governance/approvals persona_lifecycle_transition API with deterministic ids and Idempotency-Keys, then the persona owner PATCH /lifecycle cites that real governance decision id; tenant read-back checked. No issuer/grant/MFA added; Governance unchanged.
5_retire_on_decay.runtime: services/evolution/decay_monitor.py (DecayMonitor/WindowLedger), run by auto_consumer_runtime.run_consumer_tick on every scheduler tick before the consumer: telemetry runtime summaries of paper discovery bindings -> durable window ledger -> evaluate_paper_decay against approved baselines (expected_sharpe_ratio/expected_drawdown with policy_source; none = no retire) -> deterministic idempotent retire proposal -> automated gate -> governed persona retire. Failed proposals are retried next tick; replay is a no-op; evidence events recorded.
